summary: This is a Form 424B5 prospectus supplement filed by multiple AerCap entities (Aviation Solutions B.V., Funding DAC, Ireland Capital DAC, etc.) under Rule 424(b)(5) of the Securities Act. The filing relates to a takedown off an existing shelf registration (File No. 333-297097) for the issuance of debt securities. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private transaction, or restructuring is described. The filing is a routine capital markets debt offering with no deal-specific terms, board recommendations, or structural notes. No risk-arb angles apply.
